autoapproveinv.title: Automatically Approve Invoice
autoapproveinv.remarks: Are Invoices automatically approved for the vendor upon receipt of the invoice?

type.title: Company Type
type.remarks: The type of company. You may select from three default types: C (courier), M (manufacturer), and V (vendor).

autosendpocancel.title: Send Vendor Transaction on PO Cancel
autosendpocancel.remarks: Select the Send Vendor Transaction on PO Cancel? box if the vendor will be sent a PO cancellation transaction when a PO or PO line is cancelled before the item(s) are received or an ASN is sent by the vendor. By default, the box is unchecked.

parentcompany.title: Parent
parentcompany.remarks: The parent company of this company.

fax.title: Company Fax
fax.remarks: Fax number of the company or contact.

mnetcompanyid.title: E-commerce Supplier
mnetcompanyid.remarks: The ID number or string value that identifies the e-commerce supplier from whose catalog you will be ordering. This number is not necessarily a unique identifier.

banknum.title: Bank Reference #
banknum.remarks: Bank and branch identification reference number. Used to transfer funds electronically and allow transfer of dollars between buyer and seller.

catalogname.title: Catalog
catalogname.remarks: The outside vendor's catalog that you can access on the Internet. When the Punchout Enabled? box is checked, the catalog name displays in the drop-down list for the Catalog Name field.

inclusive1.title: Pay Tax to Vendor
inclusive1.remarks: Select the Pay Tax to Vendor? box if tax is included in the invoicing cost. By default, the box is selected.

apcontrolacc.title: AP Control Account
apcontrolacc.remarks: The credit account used when the invoice is paid.

phone.title: Phone
phone.remarks: Telephone number of the company or contact.

tax1code.title: Tax Code
tax1code.remarks: Country or state tax code for the company.

vendorsendsinv.title: Vendor Sends Invoice
vendorsendsinv.remarks: Select the Vendor Sends Invoice? box if the vendor sends invoice transactions. By default, the box is unchecked.

insurexpdate.title: Expiration Date of Insurance
insurexpdate.remarks: The expiration date of liability insurance for the vendor.

remitaddress3.title: State/Province
remitaddress3.remarks: The state or province where the Remit To company is located; use the two-character code or full spelling.

remitaddress4.title: ZIP/Postal Code
remitaddress4.remarks: The Remit To company's zip or postal code.

taxexemptcode.title: Tax Exempt Code
taxexemptcode.remarks: Indicates if the company is exempt from paying taxes (for example, 1=exempt, 2=not exempt, 3=exempt resale).

ecommerceenabled.title: E-commerce Enabled
ecommerceenabled.remarks: Select the E-Commerce Enabled? box if the company is e-commerce enabled. By default, the box is unchecked.

remitaddress1.title: Address
remitaddress1.remarks: The Remit To company's street address.

remitaddress2.title: City
remitaddress2.remarks: The city where the Remit To company is located.

cellphone.title: Cell Phone
cellphone.remarks: Cell phone number of the company or contact.

disabled.title: Disqualified Vendor
disabled.remarks: Select the Disqualified Vendor? box if the company is disqualified from being used on new PRs, POs, RFQs, Invoices, or any other application that references vendors. By default, the box is unchecked.

plusappscope.title: Approval Scope
plusappscope.remarks: Scope of approval data - Approval Scope

name_longdescription.title: Name Long Description
name_longdescription.remarks: Long Description for Name Of Company

registration2.title: Registration # 2
registration2.remarks: Tax Registration number for tax type 2.

registration1.title: Registration #
registration1.remarks: The tax registration number used by the company.

registration4.title: Registration # 4
registration4.remarks: Tax registration number for tax type 4.

registration3.title: Registration # 3
registration3.remarks: Tax Registration number for tax type 3.

registration5.title: Registration # 5
registration5.remarks: Tax registration number for tax type 5.

dunsnum.title: DUNS #
dunsnum.remarks: Data Universal Numbering System number, used to uniquely identify a company and its location.

freightterms.title: Freight Terms
freightterms.remarks: A description of what is being shipped; any riders to the shipping agreement should be included here. For example, you might specify ""Fresh fruit. Perishable. Keep refrigerated. Must meet delivery dates."" Click the Long Description button to enter or view a description of the terms.

ecominterface.title: E-commerce Supplier Location
ecominterface.remarks: The name of the B2B package containing the interface mapping that enables e-commerce transactions to be routed between MAXIMO and an e-commerce supplier. For example, the name of the B2B package might be mroOAGAdapter.

plusqstdate.title: Quality Status Date
plusqstdate.remarks: Date the company quality status was changed

customernum.title: Customer #
customernum.remarks: The number used by an outside company to identify your own company.

currencycode.title: Currency
currencycode.remarks: The currency that the company uses. This value is used for currency conversion, when necessary.

address4.title: ZIP/Postal Code
address4.remarks: The company's zip or postal code.

punchoutenabled.title: Punchout Enabled
punchoutenabled.remarks: Select the Punchout Enabled? box if you have can use the Companies application to search marketplace web sites for purchases. By default, the box is unchecked.

vendorsendsasn.title: Vendor Sends ASN
vendorsendsasn.remarks: Select the Vendor Sends ASN? box if the vendor sends electronic ASN (advance ship notice) transactions. By default, the box is unchecked.

vendorsendsstatus.title: Vendor Sends Order Status
vendorsendsstatus.remarks: Select the Vendor Sends Order Status? box if the vendor sends an electronic transaction detailing the status of orders. By default, the box is unchecked.

taxexemptnum.title: Tax Exempt Number
taxexemptnum.remarks: The company's National Tax Exempt Number for tax reporting purposes.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The name of the organization associated with this company.

inspectionrequired.title: Inspection Required
inspectionrequired.remarks: Indicates whether items purchased from this vendor should be inspected on receipt.

shipvia.title: Ship Via
shipvia.remarks: Specifies how the goods are shipped (for example, First Class Mail, UPS, FEDEX).

pluslimdesc.title: Limitations Description
pluslimdesc.remarks: Scope of approval data - Limitations Description

rbniacc.title: RBNI Account
rbniacc.remarks: The account for receipts that have not been invoiced.

fob.title: FOB Point
fob.remarks: Free on board point; the point where responsibility and liability are transferred. The FOB point is usually either the destination or the shipping point.

name.title: Description
name.remarks: Name and/or description of the company.  To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

apsuspenseacc.title: Suspense Account
apsuspenseacc.remarks: The credit account used when the invoice is approved.

paymentterms.title: Payment Terms
paymentterms.remarks: The specified terms of payment for this vendor. For example, you might enter: 2/10, net 30. This indicates that if the invoice is paid within ten days, the company will get a two percent discount (""2/10""). The invoice total must be paid within 30 days (""net 30"").

payvendor.title: Pay To
payvendor.remarks: Vendor code to which payment is to be made.

bankaccount.title: Bank
bankaccount.remarks: Vendor bank account for direct credits.

defaultwarehouse.title: Default Warehouse
defaultwarehouse.remarks: The default warehouse used by the vendor.

autoreceiveonasn.title: Automatically Approve Receipt on ASN
autoreceiveonasn.remarks: Select the Auto Approve Receipt on ASN? box if the receipt of items can be automatically processed when an ASN for those items has been received. By default, the box is not selected.

payonreceipt.title: Payment on Receipt
payonreceipt.remarks: Select the Payment on Receipt? box if you have a payment on receipt agreement with the company. By default, the box is unchecked.

company.title: Company
company.remarks: Identifier of the company record. This field must be unique within an organization. When you save a company record, this field becomes read-only.

useparentremitto.title: Use Parent Remit To
useparentremitto.remarks: Select the Use Parent Remit To? box to use the parent's remit to information on invoices created against the child company. The default value is unselected.

address3.title: State/Province
address3.remarks: The state or province where the company is located; use either the two-character code or full spelling.

address2.title: City
address2.remarks: The city where the company is located.

homepage.title: Home Page
homepage.remarks: Home Page number for the company. This number is the URL of the company's World Wide Web address.
